🔥 The fire settles. Jamie has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Brian mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Ella breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

"The rat's eyes INFLATE before a shutdown — and it posts its demands first, a real readable list. Your abilities, your items, the grid itself goes on strike: dead turns where nothing works. The strike is always announced." "Work-to-rule. Every gear turns at exactly the minimum. The slowdown is a thousand small cuts, all of them on you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Brian breathes "So it bleeds." Ros

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. David speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Priya.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 2 people, 33 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
A mother from The Red Table pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.

Fresh-cut stems on the west ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

The west ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the west ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the west ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🗣️ Jamie to David, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
⛓️ David brings it home: The Red Table bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
